high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "gabikovalenko." The post features a collage of six photographs showcasing different pyramids from around the world. Each photograph is labeled with the name of the pyramid and its associated civilization. Top Left: A photograph of the Pyramid of Khufu (also known as the Great Pyramid of Giza), labeled as "Egyptians." Top Right: A photograph of the Chichen Itza pyramid, labeled as "Mesoamerican." Middle Left: A photograph of the Pyramid of Khafre, also labeled as "Egyptians
